- **Step 2 (ambiguity)**: Issue #4407 has no plan block and no partition strategy for the 4-way Python unit-test CI split; the body says "about 1/4" each plus "add timing output ... to be able to repartition".
  **A**: Round-robin by pytest collection index via a no-op-unless-set conftest.py hook gated on PYTEST_SHARD_ID / PYTEST_SHARD_COUNT (local make py-test and targeted harness runs still run the full collection); per-test timing via --durations=0 on the make py-test target so shards can be rebalanced by wall time later. No pytest plugin dependency added.

- **Step implement-bootstrap emergency-bypass-log — /implement --emergency preflight bypassed (exit 0)**:
  ```
BYPASS kind=missing-designed-prefix issue=4407
BYPASS kind=missing-plan issue=4407
BYPASS kind=audit-refuse issue=4407
  ```
- **Step 5 (self-review)**: Splitting the `python-tests` CI job into a 4-way `shard` matrix renames its GitHub check from `python-tests (3.11)` to `python-tests (3.11, 1)` … `(3.11, 4)`. If branch protection or any required-status-check rule pins the old `python-tests` name, a maintainer must update the required-check settings to the new sharded names (or a name pattern). No code action; GitHub repo settings only.
- **Step 5 (self-review)**: main-agent inline self-review complete; reviewed all 5 changed files against correctness / security / edge-cases / style / tests; no code fixes warranted.
- **Step 6**: pre-/review untracked baseline missing; untracked delta not computed for this run (self-review mode). FILES_CHANGED=false from staged+unstaged is authoritative; no review edits were made.

- **Step 2 (ambiguity)**: Issue #4407 has no plan block and no partition strategy for the 4-way Python unit-test CI split; the body says "about 1/4" each plus "add timing output ... to be able to repartition".
  **A**: Round-robin by pytest collection index via a no-op-unless-set `conftest.py` hook gated on `PYTEST_SHARD_ID` / `PYTEST_SHARD_COUNT` (local `make py-test` and targeted harness runs still run the full collection); per-test timing via `--durations=0` on the `make py-test` target so shards can be rebalanced by wall time later. Matches the issue's "about 1/4 now, timing to repartition later" intent without adding a pytest plugin dependency.
